vulnerability.name: USN-6128-2
vulnerability.description: USN-6128-1 fixed a vulnerability in CUPS. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that CUPS incorrectly handled logging. A remote attacker  could use this issue to cause CUPS to crash, resulting in a denial of  service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: CUPS could be made to crash or run programs if it received specially crafted network traffic. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
